description: Pre-validated recommendation seeds for new PS deployments. These bootstrap Gate 8.2 before enough operational data has accumulated to generate organic recommendations.

recommendations.title: Run the Milestone Review workflow for all active projects
recommendations.description: 7-day pre-milestone health checks prevent last-minute escalations. Run on all active projects this week.

recommendations.title: Set COIG baseline now
recommendations.description: Without a baseline snapshot, no COIG number can be computed. Save one immediately to start measuring improvement.

recommendations.title: Run Lead Qualification on all unscored leads
recommendations.description: Leads without a DEAL_COACH qualification score have no actionable priority signal. Run qualification flow on all PROSPECT-status leads.

recommendations.title: Clear L3 approval backlog
recommendations.description: Pending L3 approvals that are > 48h old are suppressing the Decision Intelligence pillar. Review and act.

recommendations.title: Activate all 9 workflow templates
recommendations.description: Only activated workflows contribute to Adoption Intelligence. Trigger each template at least once to establish a baseline.
